title: Calder’s Mountains And Clouds Reunited in Capitol Hill
summary: Alexander Calder’s sculpture Mountains and Clouds, 1976, has returned to Capitol Hill. The monochromatic work is composed of a vertical element representing mountains and four planes of metal arranged parallel to the floor are gently rotated by a motor. After a 2011 earthquake raised safety concerns, a structural analysis of the hanging elements was prompted […]

title: Virginia Anderson Named Senior Curator of American Art At The National Gallery Of Art
summary: The National Gallery of Art has named Virginia Anderson the Christiane Ellis Valone Senior Curator of American Art and head of the art of the Americas, starting in November. Anderson is currently the senior curator of American art and department head of American painting and sculpture and decorative arts at the Baltimore Museum of Art […]

title: Blind Man Sues Over Lack of Audio Tours for Bayeux Tapestry
summary: Dr. Yusuf Ali Osman, a registered blind man, has filed suit against the British Museum, claiming the London institution failed to comply with the Equality Act by not providing audio-described guides at its exhibition of the famed Bayeux Tapestry. title: Bronner Family of Collectors Awarded Art Cologne Prize
summary: Three generations of the Düsseldorf-based Bronner family have been recognized with the 2026 Art Cologne Prize, which recognizes the commitment to collecting, promoting, and making art accessible to the public.
